fact: The Réseau des Femmes Leaders pour le Développement (RFLD) held a three-day West Africa Feminist Data Summit in Porto-Novo on 28-30 July 2026, per its own report, with about 100 delegates including researchers, where tracks on censorship and shutdowns, TFGBV and decolonising data and AI each produced a policy brief on a legislative or regulatory gap.

The programme of the West African Forum on Digital Transformations (Cotonou, 7-9 July 2026) schedules Dr Issifou Abou Moumouni of LASDEL Benin to present research results on the digitalisation of public services in Benin.

Dr Julien Hounkpe, lecturer at the University of Abomey-Calavi and researcher at its CREDIJ, presented a critique of the Code du numerique to MPs at a National Assembly workshop in Porto-Novo on 12 January 2024 on revising the Code.

GDN's programme page lists Benin institutions (Laboratoire Société-Environnement, Laboratoire d'Economie Publique, LASDEL, CESPO, CERMAQ) in research consortia on digital transformation, with proposals presented at the Cotonou forum of 7-9 July 2026.
